name: With Me Forever
source:
The world is long gone and everything fell apart, while searching for food you find a little robot in a ruin and decide to help her find her lost "father".

[From [url=https://sunetraalex.itch.io/with-me-forever]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
世界早已不复存在，一切都分崩离析，在寻找食物时，你在废墟中发现了一个小机器人，并决定帮助她找到失去的“父亲”。

[来自[url=https://sunetraalex.itch.io/with-me-forever]Itch.io[/url]]
